sentences.text: Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No. 953 of 2023, under Sections 307, 323, 342, 354, 498A,
506 Ipc and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station Manglour, District
Haridwar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, The victim, who is daughter of the informant and the applicant Aman were married on 27.02.2022.
After marriage, the victim was harassed and tortured for and in connection with the demand of dowry.
She was molested also in the family by her in-laws.
Attempt was made to administer poison to her.
The FIR is quite in detail.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that entire family of the husband has been roped in the matter.
It is a matrimonial discord.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that as per instruction, the victim had taken honey and ghee together, therefore, she had some poisoning symptoms.
6. State to file objections within three weeks.

7. List on 02.04.2024.

sentences.text:
8. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing person bond, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner whatsoever, the victim or any other witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.

(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i),
(ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 16.02.2024.
